subject.title: Adopt warning-free SwiftFormat 0.62.1 rules across Apple sources

question: Should maintainers refresh the broad linked PR as the canonical implementation, or replace it with a narrower current-main branch before adopting the warning-free Apple tooling policy?
rationale: The desired end state is clear and previously well-proven, but the active 268-file branch is now conflicting and has failing checks, so automation cannot safely choose whether to preserve or replace it.

options.title: Refresh canonical PR
options.body: Resolve the linked PR's conflicts, preserve its single-policy tooling design, and rerun exact-head Apple proof before merge.

options.title: Recreate current-main branch
options.body: Replace the conflicting branch with a reviewable current-main implementation that retains every acceptance criterion and the existing proof standard.

options.title: Retain workaround
options.body: Keep the three rules disabled and close the cluster only if maintainers intentionally reject the stronger warning-free policy.

recommendation.title: Refresh canonical PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the linked PR's conflicts, preserve its single-policy tooling design, and rerun exact-head Apple proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns both the merged workaround and the complete follow-up implementation history.
